title: NightSubmit
description: Client to server, event `night:submit`. The Monster picks victims; a Villager names who they suspect. The server checks the sender's role, so both shapes use the same event.

MonsterKill.description: Monster only. One victim, or two when the Werewolf uses its power (never on Night 1).

VillagerHunch.description: Villager only. Answer to "Who do you suspect?". Shown as an end-game stat; it has no effect.
